subject: Web Development
title: GeoCities and the Personal Web
description: A micro-lesson that makes GeoCities and the Personal Web usable.

hook.text: In 1994, anyone could build a homepage for free. GeoCities gave everyone a web address.

buildup.text: Users picked a 'neighborhood' — Hollywood for fun, SiliconValley for tech.

discovery.text: Millions created pages with animated GIFs, visitor counters, and blinking text.

twist.text: Yahoo bought GeoCities for $3.6 billion, then shut it down ten years later.

climax.text: Archivists raced to save millions of personal pages before they vanished forever.

punchline.text: The first social web died with a corporate memo.

quiz.question: Who bought and later shut down GeoCities?
